title: R3 carrier and yoke - arrangement register

sections.heading: Document control
sections.text: Status: superseded by revision C before 14 October 2024. Applicability: normal rolling arrangement, backup rolls installed, carrier seated and centered.

sections.heading: Arrangement
sections.text: This arrangement includes a backup-roll-associated stop. Centered keeper contact is shown; full offset travel is not qualified.

sections.heading: Boundary
sections.text: Do not infer that the backup-roll-associated stop remains present when backup rolls are removed. No maintenance-state travel envelope is specified.
